gui-hint: Changes apply immediately. Hover a setting for details, right-click it to reset. Ctrl+Click a slider to type any value, negative values invert an effect.
gui-revert-desc: Discard unsaved changes and read the config file again.
gui-defaults-desc: Set every value to its default. Nothing is written until you save or close the window.
gui-contexts-hint: Each profile is used in its own situation, and switching between them is smoothly blended. Priority: boats and vehicles, mounts, swimming, glider, sprinting, walking.
setting-enabled-desc: Toggles all of the mod's features.
setting-enableinthirdperson-desc: Disable this to make the effects exclusive to the first-person view.
setting-aimfollowscamera-desc: Targets blocks and creatures through the center of the screen, so the crosshair always marks what you interact with, even while the camera lags behind a fast turn. Turn off to target along the vanilla look direction, like the original mod does. Arrows and thrown items always fly along the vanilla look direction.
setting-contexttransitionsmoothing-desc: How smooth transitions between movement profiles, such as walking and swimming, should be. 0 switches instantly.
setting-turningrollaccumulation-desc: Sensitivity of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-turningrollintensity-desc: Maximum strength of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-turningrollsmoothing-desc: Smoothness of the decay of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-cameraswayintensity-desc: Strength of the smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfrequency-desc: Frequency of the smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfadeindelay-desc: How long the player must idle before the sway starts to fade in.
setting-cameraswayfadeinlength-desc: How long it takes the sway to fully fade in once the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfadeoutlength-desc: How long it takes the sway to fade out when the player starts moving again.
setting-screenshakesmaxintensity-desc: Maximum strength of all screen shakes, in degrees. 0 disables screen shakes.
setting-screenshakesmaxfrequency-desc: How fast screen shakes change direction or oscillate.
setting-explosiontrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake caused by explosions (bombs and anything else that uses the game's explosion) and lightning strikes nearby.
setting-thundertrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the long rumble caused by lightning strikes within 192 blocks.
setting-handswingtrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake caused by attacking, breaking and placing blocks. Best kept very low.
setting-strafingrollfactor-desc: Strength of the camera roll caused by strafing, i.e. sideways horizontal velocity. The glider uses a negative value, so the camera banks into turns like elytra do.
setting-forwardvelocitypitchfactor-desc: Strength of the camera pitch caused by moving forward or backwards.
setting-verticalvelocitypitchfactor-desc: Strength of the camera pitch caused by vertical velocity: jumping, falling, diving with the glider.
setting-horizontalvelocitysmoothingfacto: Smoothness of the camera pitch and roll caused by moving horizontally. Higher is smoother, values around 100 and above become extremely sluggish.
setting-verticalvelocitysmoothingfactor-: Smoothness of the camera pitch caused by moving vertically. The base value is very fast, so noticeable smoothing needs values in the hundreds or thousands.
setting-camerasmoothing-desc: Smooths the rendered pitch and yaw of the camera. Your actual turning is not slowed down; with 'Targeting follows the camera' on, block and creature targeting follows the smoothed view.
command-toggle-description: Turn all camera effects on or off
command-settings-unavailable: The settings window needs the Dear ImGui (vsimgui) mod, Config lib is recommended too. Without them, edit ModConfig/{0} and run .dcam reload.
